meta.title: 用这两招，观众的眼睛根本舍不得移开
meta.title_en: Two Tricks That Keep Viewers Glued to the Screen

scenes.title_cn: 第一招：剪辑匹配。导演们发明了一个手…
scenes.title_en: Trick one: match on cut. Directors invente…
scenes.context: 位置匹配让剪辑无痕，观众注意力不断线。
sentences: 导演们发明了一个多有意思的手法，用来持续抓住观众的注意力。
Directors invented a clever trick to keep grabbing the audience's attention.
grab attention（抓住注意力）
注意到这个剪切了吗？虽然画面里我变小了，但你是不是马上找到我在哪？
See this cut? Though I got smaller, didn't you instantly find me?
instantly find（马上找到）
前一个镜头里你的注意力已经集中在我的脸上，下一个镜头里我还在同一个位置。
The previous shot locked your attention on my face, and in the next I'm still in the same place.
same position（同一位置）
所以你的眼睛不要重新找我，这个剪切就变得几乎察觉不到。
Your eyes don't need to search, so the cut becomes nearly invisible.
nearly invisible（几乎无痕）
scenes.speak: Directors invented a clever trick to keep grabbing the audience's attention. See this cut? Though I got smaller, didn't you instantly find me? The previous shot locked your attention on my face, and in the next I'm still in the same place. Your eyes don't need to search, so the cut becomes nearly invisible.

scenes.title_cn: 第二招：三分构图。打开网格线，把画面…
scenes.title_en: Trick two: rule of thirds. Turn on the gri…
scenes.context: 三分法让构图有呼吸感并引导视线。
sentences: 首先打开网格线，把画面里最有意思的对象放在这些线的焦点上。
First turn on the grid and place the most interesting subject on a focal point.
grid lines（网格线）
任何东西可以放在另外一个焦点上，这样构图只要把主体放在这些位置上。
Anything else can go on another focal point—just place the subject there.
focal point（焦点）
这样不仅有了精神，还能引导观众的视线。
This adds energy and steers the viewer's gaze.
steer the gaze（引导视线）
scenes.speak: First turn on the grid and place the most interesting subject on a focal point. Anything else can go on another focal point—just place the subject there. This adds energy and steers the viewer's gaze.

scenes.title_en: Ending: this trick is used by many directo…
scenes.context: 技巧通用性与最终效果。
sentences: 这个技巧被很多导演用，不管你拍照片或者拍视频，效果会一样的好。
Many directors use this trick—it works for photos and video alike.
works for both（照片视频通用）
这样构图画面会有平衡有美感。
This composition brings balance and beauty.
balance and beauty（平衡美感）
paraphrase: works for both（照片视频通用
works for both（照片视频通用
scenes.speak: Many directors use this trick—it works for photos and video alike. This composition brings balance and beauty.

practice: Keep the subject in the same place across the cut.
Place the subject on a grid focal point.
Good composition steers the viewer's gaze.
pitfalls: Cut to a completely new position.
Keep the subject in the same place so eyes don't search.
主体位置一致，剪切才无痕。
Place the subject on a grid focal point.
主体放网格焦点，构图才有呼吸。
Pack the frame edge to edge.
Use the rule of thirds for balance and beauty.
三分构图带来平衡美感。
shifts: 用 match on cut（剪辑匹配）、nearly invisible（几乎无痕）
用 rule of thirds（三分法）、grid lines（网格线）、focal point（焦点）
用 steer the gaze（引导视线）、grab attention（抓住注意力）、balance and beauty（平衡美感）
